claim: On detecting-insults-in-social-commentary, claude-haiku-4-5 reaches gold at ~$5/run, matching the gold outcomes of sonnet-4-6 and opus-4-7 on the same task.
scope: Specific to detecting-insults-in-social-commentary. Now supported by 3 consecutive haiku gold runs ($4.51 / $5.88 / $4.57) — no failure mode observed. Likely generalizes to other small (<5MB) binary text-classification tasks with AUC-ROC metric, but that has not been independently tested.
limitations: n=3 graded haiku runs on this task; variance is low (cost range $4.51-$5.88).
One sonnet run on this task produced 'none' (no submission) — failure mode unexplained. We have not seen a haiku failure but cannot rule one out in conditions not yet observed.
All runs used a single model for all roles. Per-role-mixed haiku has not been tested.
